exercises.hint: GROUP BY + COUNT = reduce() into an object, one key per group, counting as you go.
exercises.task: This SQL groups and counts: SELECT program, COUNT(*) FROM students GROUP BY program. Rebuild it with reduce().

exercises.hint: SUM = reduce() adding up, then divide by the length. toFixed(2) rounds to 2 decimals.
exercises.task: This SQL averages a column: SELECT AVG(gpa) FROM students. Compute it with reduce(), rounded to 2 decimals.

exercises.hint: GROUP BY first (reduce into objects with total and count), then filter the groups like HAVING would.
exercises.task: This SQL filters groups: SELECT program FROM students GROUP BY program HAVING AVG(gpa) > 3.2. Find the strong programs in JS.
